586:t_1:4.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「I was surprised, Big Sis. Just when I thought I'd finally seen you again, all that happened out of nowhere.」

586:t_1:5.en:
$$カズミ$$
「It truly was a mystery of the universe... And we overcame it to meet again.」

586:t_1:8.en:
$$カズミ$$
「You're $$ノノ$$, then. $$ノリコ$$ told me most of your story.」

586:t_1:9.en:
$$カズミ$$
「I'm $$オオタ・カズミ$$, the pilot of $$バスターマシン２号$$.」

586:t_1:10.en:
$$カズミ$$
「We both pilot $$バスターマシン$$s... Well, you're a $$バスターマシン$$ yourself, but would you be my friend?」

586:t_1:12.en:
$$カズミ$$
「I'm counting on you from now on. ...May I call you $$ノノ$$?」

586:t_1:14.en:
$$チコ$$
「What's this, $$ノノ$$...? Are you trading in your Big Sis?」

586:t_1:15.en:
$$ノノ$$
「What are you saying, $$チコ$$!? $$ノノ$$'s Big Sis will forever be...」

586:t_1:17.en:
$$チコ$$
「I don't know what happened between you and Princess, but hurry up and make up with her.」

586:t_1:18.en:
$$チコ$$
「I don't want the $$バラの女王$$ saying the $$バスターマシン$$ pilots from our time have no spirit.」

586:t_1:20.en:
$$カズミ$$
「I'll be expecting great things from you, $$ノノ$$.」

586:t_1:21.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「You don't have to worry, Big Sis. $$ノノ$$ and $$ラルク$$ are the best team after you and me.」

586:t_1:22.en:
$$ノリコ$$
(That's right, isn't it, $$ノノ$$, $$ラルク$$...?)

586:t_1:23.en:
$$アムロ$$
「...I never imagined one person's wish would transport $c...」

586:t_1:24.en:
$$シャア$$
「I think my wish was picked up almost at random, rather than because I was anyone special.」

586:t_1:25.en:
$$桂$$
「I felt how insane the situation was back then, too.」

586:t_1:26.en:
$$桂$$
「That sense of everyone's feelings swirling around was like the space-time repair during the $$多元戦争$$, but the chaos was unbelievable.」

586:t_1:27.en:
$$アムロ$$
「So we were in an unusual situation at the time...」

586:t_1:28.en:
$$万丈$$
「The distortion in the dimensional boundary seems stable now, but we don't know what might happen next, or when.」

586:t_1:29.en:
$$シャア$$
「Worst case, a full-scale $$バアル$$ invasion could begin from that hole...」

586:t_1:30.en:
$$オルソン$$
「Space-time could collapse before that happens.」

586:t_1:31.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「As for the three keys... It seems the third $$特異点$$ wasn't Miss $$千鳥かなめ$$.」

586:t_1:32.en:
$$オルソン$$
「She was the $$特異点$$ of the $$ウィスパード$$ phenomenon, but with her ability gone, we should assume $$サイデリアル$$'s key is someone else.」

586:t_1:34.en:
$$桂$$
(Thanks to $$レナード$$ treating me as an enemy, I'm starting to see who that third person is...)

586:t_1:38.en:
$$桂$$
(If it's that person, we need to be careful. Anyone in that group has to be seriously twisted...)

586:t_1:39.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「So our search for the three keys is back to square one...」

586:t_1:40.en:
$$万丈$$
「Then asking the source of that information directly would be the quickest way.」

586:t_1:42.en:
$$アムロ$$
「Our arrival on $$蒼の地球$$ spurred each of the three $$リアクター$$s into action. As a result, their fronts in various areas have gradually thinned out.」

586:t_1:43.en:
$$万丈$$
「Preparations for the counteroffensive should have progressed in the meantime, too.」

586:t_1:44.en:
$$桂$$
「So all we have left is to pick the right time to go.」

586:t_1:45.en:
$$オルソン$$
「Those black $$アンゲロイ$$ may show up there, too...」

586:t_1:46.en:
$$アムロ$$
「It seems they're secretly manipulating the history of various worlds.」

586:t_1:47.en:
$$万丈$$
「It's a good opportunity. I'd like to finally clarify the connection between the fundamental calamity and $$サイデリアル$$.」

586:t_1:48.en:
$$シャア$$
「But before that, we have to settle something.」

586:t_1:49.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「You mean $$ネオ・ジオン$$...」

586:t_1:50.en:
$$オルソン$$
「Their strength has fallen with $$ハマーン・カーン$$ and $$ザフト$$ leaving. They may try a desperate move to turn things around.」

586:t_1:51.en:
$$アムロ$$
「$$ラプラスの箱$$ will likely be the focal point of that battle.」

586:t_1:52.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「It holds something powerful enough to overthrow the $$地球連邦$$...」

586:t_1:53.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「If it falls into $$フル・フロンタル$$'s hands, cunning as he is, he'll use it to break up the forces opposing the Empire in each region.」

586:t_1:54.en:
$$万丈$$
「I want to avoid that at all costs at this stage.」

586:t_1:55.en:
$$桂$$
「I don't like it... That gentleman always comes up with such practical schemes.」

586:t_1:56.en:
$$シャア$$
「He is precisely what I would be with all my softness removed.」

586:t_1:57.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「Judging by that smile... you've put your doubts behind you.」

586:t_1:58.en:
$$シャア$$
「We've been given a miracle. If I can't turn it into strength, I couldn't face everyone I inconvenienced.」

586:t_1:59.en:
$$桂$$
「That's good, very good. If our chief doesn't make up his mind, the younger ones will feel uneasy, too.」

586:t_1:61.en:
$$万丈$$
「We mean that as you are now, you may be able to shoulder $c... No, all of humanity.」

586:t_1:63.en:
$$シャア$$
「Besides, humanity's future isn't so light that any one person can shoulder it.」

586:t_1:64.en:
$$アムロ$$
「But you must understand that your position doesn't allow you to abandon that responsibility, either.」

586:t_1:65.en:
$$シャア$$
「So my family line is destined to be sacrificed.」

586:t_1:66.en:
$$アムロ$$
「Everyone has a role. It's much like $$クロウ$$ and the others' knack for drawing the short straw, or $n and the others' volunteer spirit.」

586:t_1:67.en:
$$シャア$$
「...There's a barrier we have to overcome first.」

586:t_1:68.en:
$$アムロ$$
「You mean the final phase of $$オペレーション・エクリプス$$...」

586:t_1:69.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「And we must settle things with $$フル・フロンタル$$, who will likely make his move before that.」

586:t_1:70.en:
$$アムロ$$
「To prepare to face him, $c apparently plans to finish resupplying at the $$ソレスタルビーイング号$$.」

586:t_1:71.en:
$$シャア$$
「So that will be where we fight the decisive battle with $$ネオ・ジオン$$...」

586:t_1:72.en:
$$桂$$
「The fight over $$ラプラスの箱$$ that began in the $$時獄戦役$$ is finally reaching its climax.」

586:t_1:73.en:
$$万丈$$
「It may be inappropriate, but after all this, I am curious about what's inside the Box.」

586:t_1:74.en:
$$シャア$$
「Let's leave the decision to reveal it to those entrusted with the Box.」

586:t_1:75.en:
$$桂$$
「You mean $$バナージ$$ and Princess $$ミネバ$$.」

586:t_1:76.en:
$$アムロ$$
「I'd like to believe they'll use its power to build a future...」

586:t_1:80.en: ～$$ネオ・ジオン$$ Leader's　Private Quarters～

586:t_1:81.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「...Does your telling me the truth mean you acknowledge me as the inheritor of humanity?」

586:t_1:82.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「That depends on what you do from now on.」

586:t_1:83.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「I understand. Then I shall seal away the Box through my own efforts.」

586:t_1:84.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「To save humanity from despair.」

586:t_1:85.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「I'll be expecting great things from you.」
